parameters.name: InstanceId
parameters.description: The IDs of the bastion host instances.

parameters.name: InstanceStatus
parameters.description:
The status of the bastion host instance. Valid values:

- **PENDING**: The instance is not initialized.

- **CREATING**: The instance is being created.

- **RUNNING**: The instance is running.

- **EXPIRED**: The instance is expired.

- **CREATE\_FAILED**: The instance creation failed.

- **UPGRADING**: The instance is being upgraded.

- **UPGRADE\_FAILED**: The instance upgrade failed.

parameters.name: PageNumber
parameters.description: The page number to return. Default value: **1**.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The number of bastion host instances to return on each page. Default value: **10**.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description: The ID of the region in which the bastion host instances reside.

parameters.name: ResourceGroupId
parameters.description: The ID of the resource group to which the bastion host instance belongs.

parameters.name: Tag
parameters.description: The tags attached to the bastion host instances.
